entries.mem0ai/mem0: This universal memory layer provides multi-level storage for user, session, and agent states using temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval. It is available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server, an OSS SDK, or a managed cloud service.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: This context database organizes information as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs and a tiered L0/L1/L2 loading system. It achieved a 91% token reduction and significant task-completion gains on LoCoMo10 while providing observable retrieval trajectories for debugging.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee is a self-hosted knowledge graph engine designed to give agents persistent long-term memory across multiple sessions. It supports unified ingestion and multimodal data search through Python, Rust, and TypeScript clients.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain generates cited prose answers and performs explicit gap analysis to identify missing information. It builds knowledge graphs using typed edges without LLM calls and ensures data isolation through scoped institutional memory.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: This engine features a custom vector graph engine and byte-level deduplication to support sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month. It automates fact extraction and user profiling using connectors for platforms like Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight implements long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows to help agents learn over time. The system supports over 25 LLM providers and offers deployment flexibility via Docker, Kubernetes, or managed cloud environments.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This library serves as the core logic for building stateful agents and acts as the upstream dependency for the honcho-self-hosted wrapper. It provides FastAPI-based service logic and SDKs for managing sessions and peer relationships.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This system manages memory as a git-like repository, utilizing a 5-tier retrieval process where four tiers are non-LLM based for sub-100ms performance. It features an interactive TUI and supports version control operations like branching and merging over a markdown context tree.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency, sub-millisecond memory system that utilizes a single SQLite database for local storage. It integrates with Hermes via MCP, a Python SDK, or OpenWebUI and requires only Python 3.10 or higher.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system utilizes Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage structured facts and an auto-curated wiki. It employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize specifically injected context during recall.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: This recursive harness produces filesystem-first artifacts, such as playbooks and context bundles, to improve agent performance on complex tasks. It features outcome-gated promotion and ablation-backed attribution to validate changes to the agent's context.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides lossless context management by using a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store to ensure no messages are lost. It includes specialized recall tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall to help agents recover specific details from their history.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes existing local session history from over 20 coding agents to enable millisecond lookups across months of past data. It prioritizes security by redacting keys and tokens during the indexing process of gigabytes of historical data.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: Honcho provides a self-hosted backend for private cross-session memory that supports any OpenAI-compatible LLM or local inference server. It includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis to facilitate deployment for Hermes Agent.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI maintains a living semantic ontology through a background process called dreaming to provide a local-first identity and memory layer. It supports real-time ingestion from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub while integrating with harnesses like Hermes Agent and Gemini CLI.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer stores data as human-readable YAML files on local disk using an open engram format. It retrieves information through a hybrid search combining BM25 and local embeddings, integrating directly with MCP tools.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates locally without API keys or cloud dependencies. It utilizes hybrid retrieval, including BM25 and vector search, and integrates via MCP, plugins, and Claude Code hooks.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes long-context inference by reordering and deduplicating blocks to enable prefix reuse. This approach reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saves up to 36% of tokens within the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based long-term memory system that uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It is delivered as a five-package plugin family that includes an SDK, CLI, and a dedicated Hermes adapter.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable recall by attaching a 'why_retrieved' tag to every result and includes a loop to resolve knowledge gaps. It supports owner-scoping for multi-user environments and features contradiction tracking and recency ranking.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as the source of truth, storing memory as inspectable Markdown files rather than opaque databases. It runs locally without a daemon or telemetry, utilizing DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack acts as a memory kernel stack that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide agents with purpose-built evidence packets per query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by watching agent session logs and storing data locally via SQLite-vec. It is an MCP-native server that uses GGUF models to provide RAG and vector search capabilities.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts before the context window opens, resulting in up to 94% fewer prompt tokens. It employs a local-first architecture using SQLite and FTS5 and supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP) via stdio and SSE.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This provider offers reflective memory through semantic search that combines BM25 full-text indexing with ranked graph traversal. It automates indexing for codebases and multimedia via OCR, using edge tags to establish navigable, bidirectional relationships between stored notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: Designed to minimize prompt token overhead, this tool uses local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool schemas for Hermes Agent v0.14.0. It includes a dedicated dashboard for monitoring estimated schema token savings and supports native tool search functionality.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a columnar .lbdb embedded graph database to store memories with a built-in 1-10 importance ranking. It prioritizes high-value information during context prefetch using BM25-first retrieval and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: A Git-backed workflow layer that stores identity, decisions, and workflows in plain Markdown files for coding agents like Claude Code and Codex. It facilitates source-neutral migrations for chats and documents, serving as a structured context layer for development tasks.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin features a pull-model with an on-demand summarizer and a trace.jsonl audit log for tracking all prefetch operations. It addresses persistent recall issues by supporting real, immediate event deletion to ensure removed data does not influence future responses.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables agents to handle financial transactions across 29 chains, including EVM and Solana, with 0% transaction fees. It allows Hermes agents to pay for services or charge for API access directly through integrated wallet settlements.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local skills, scripts, and MCP server configurations to improve agent routing through artifact search and graph neighbor traversal. It utilizes both implicit and explicit feedback to refine routing hints for local capability discovery.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: Providing durable cross-session memory, this plugin features pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots for state persistence. It relies on a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox to manage searching, remembering, and updating agent state.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory for Hermes agents. It supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to optimize the retrieval of manually stored or searched memories.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: An AI-native memory solution that secures data with AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and offers retrieval via HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index methods. It can be deployed through native Rust FFI or an HTTP daemon and includes MinHash deduplication and metadata filters.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory by adding deterministic slash commands for searching, syncing, and reading repository files. It requires a local SourceVault server to handle indexing and vector storage for grounded Q&A and structured tool use.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider features 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search method that combines BM25, vector, and graph techniques. It also performs automatic context checkpointing during message compression to maintain continuity.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This tool provides a file-based curation loop for agent memory that uses a git-backed directory to manage versioned, diffable markdown files. It features 'rot' and 'lint' curators to identify stale or conflicting data and includes five slash commands for capture, recall, and curation.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a subagent-driven development process to execute tasks autonomously. It enforces test-driven development and YAGNI principles while integrating as a plugin for various coding harnesses and CLIs.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system for generating prototypes, decks, and documents using real CSS and components on macOS and Windows. It supports coding-agent CLI workflows, including Hermes Agent, and integrates with DeepSeek Harness and OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, and NIST AI RMF. The skills are compatible with over 26 AI platforms to support standardized cybersecurity operations.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill converts natural language, SQL, and IaC into .drawio diagrams while preserving manual layout adjustments during updates. It also enforces architecture contracts through YAML/JSON rules and Diagram-as-Test functionality.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this project provides a master router and connector skills for delegated permissions and payments. It includes a verification and dispute resolution layer alongside vendored protocol skills.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a 112-entry word replacement table. It supports rewrite and detect-only modes and is compatible with Hermes, Claude Code, and OpenClaw agents.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project unifies isolated skill silos into a shared, evolving library that natively integrates with Hermes and QwenPaw. It includes a bilingual dashboard for inspecting skills and monitoring session traces.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains session state within the project's documentation directory to support Claude Code and Codex agents.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,169 professional and life skills distributed as plain markdown files under the MIT license. The skills run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code with ready-to-paste exports for other assistants.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This tool enables Hermes Agent and Cursor to perform video searches, extract transcripts, and browse channels or playlists. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and is compatible with OpenClaw and Windsurf.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that automatically detects and proposes reusable skills based on active workflows. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, providing slash commands to manage detected patterns.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: These skills enable Hermes Agent to generate custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. The system includes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for agentskills.io using Git and S3 sources for remote skill registries. It features sandboxed execution to isolate untrusted scripts and tools for reading bundled resources.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill set transforms rough concepts into structured design documents and implementation handoffs for Hermes Agent. It offers Lite and Full modes for different project complexities and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This literate programming skill enables agents to weave prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It includes a tangler to extract runnable files and automatically syncs source code edits back to the original documentation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro is a harness for long-running agents that utilizes a mechanism kernel and Markdown-based recipes to manage work trees and immutable decision records. It implements the SLP protocol for supervised team generations and cross-role handbacks.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning to replacement models based on recorded work.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Following the Agent Skills specification, this project enables interactions with Oracle networks and smart contracts. It supports integration with CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds, alongside specialized skills for CRE and ACE services.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community-driven repository provides Hermes Agent skills, installation guides, and integrations specifically in Portuguese. All skills are formatted according to the SKILL.md and agentskills.io standards.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills provide API integration and prompting guidelines for FLUX image and video generation. The project includes a router for managing multi-step video workflows via Python and TypeScript clients.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories and developer discourse into agentskills.io-compliant skills with version-pinned instructions. It links instructions directly to source lines and provides lifecycle tooling for testing and exporting skills.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: Skilldock.io serves as a registry for reusable AI skills, offering a CLI and Python client for installation. It supports recursive dependency resolution and includes commerce features powered by TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Designed for complex multi-step tasks, this skill provides autonomous execution with real-time progress tracking. It features built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures to ensure safe recovery during long-running operations.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a local-first workflow language that audits costs, permissions, and types before execution via a single Rust binary. It generates verifiable, hash-chained receipts for every run to ensure workflow integrity.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided setup script for credential validation and configuration.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during agent interactions. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and enables incremental discovery of server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill browsing and one-click installation, this project implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates 24/7 on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search integration across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project provides a five-layer intelligent retrieval system that uses hard triggers and semantic embeddings to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. It optimizes performance by reducing token usage and offers graceful degradation if specific embedding models or dependencies are unavailable.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly personal execution system, this OS manages habits and study blocks through agent-driven scheduling via MCP. It stores data locally in a single SQLite file and includes both a React web application and an Expo-based Android app.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only tool performs adversarial code reviews by deploying three parallel subagents to identify edge cases and integration issues. It combines deterministic pre-scans using multiple security linters with proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox to verify findings.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across various interfaces like CLI, TUI, and Telegram to reduce token usage by 20–80%. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a swarm of three sub-agents to improve code hygiene, clarity, and correctness across five programming languages. It employs a tiered application process that includes a mandatory approval gate for proposed changes.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements systematic investigation protocols and multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It utilizes a Python goal engine to manage persistent task states and prevent early-stop issues during complex debugging.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern enables tool-based skill loading through Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files and automates the registration of common agent skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey cybersecurity lab equips Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 different frameworks and standards, covering real-world exploits ranging from 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This suite adds session management and worktree recovery tools to provide memory and state drift detection across agent conversations. It also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and provides scaffolding for new skill development.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible demo GIFs for repository READMEs using vhs or Playwright. It optimizes output files to remain under 8 MB and handles the direct embedding of rendered visuals into the project documentation.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This tool generates portable agent skills from plain language while preventing technical debt through a validator that detects frontmatter drift. It monitors official specifications weekly and uses CI-friendly exit codes to ensure skills remain compatible with current runtime profiles.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This project establishes a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to identify and propose new skill coverage gaps. It operates locally using the Python standard library and gates all updates behind a framework of deterministic, LLM-judge, and regression evaluators.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent across 11 monitoring tabs, including token costs and error tracking. It enforces a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry and supports optional incident alerts via Telegram and Feishu.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server enables agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and integrates with compatible clients like Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: These skills provide deterministic path routing and interpreter selection across native Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. The tool automatically verifies project-compatible Python runtimes and handles environment-specific syntax for file operations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using protocols such as Pay Link, x402, and MPP. It is designed for compatibility with the agentskills.io standard and works across OpenClaw and Hermes Agent environments.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This project certifies the quality of AI agent skills by testing their structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures and provides a public API for verification.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring accounts or API keys. It includes tools for creating bounty boards and buying context, with payments settled after human approval of the winning answer.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This hosted MCP server exposes 191 tools and five production-grade workflow skills for structured web data extraction. It supports multiple AI environments including Claude, Cursor, Goose, and OpenHands.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news briefings ranging from global to street-level perspectives. It utilizes semantic memory to align search expansion with user interests and produces structured reports containing core conclusions and action suggestions.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides specialized tools for transcribing Douyin videos, performing OCR on invoices, and extracting fields from contracts. It also features a rule-based engine designed to remove machine-like phrasing from AI-generated text.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes and various development tools. It supports both open-source and unfree licensed software binaries for use within the Nix ecosystem.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running Hermes Agent and Antigravity CLI on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables hardware and UI access by leveraging Termux:API and Termux:GUI integrations.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a one-line installation script for deploying Hermes Agent in Termux environments on Android. The setup supports over 70 tools, persistent memory, and connectivity to both external providers and local models via Ollama.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates Kubernetes deployments with a focus on single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports direct deployments or operator-ready workflows and includes a configurable gateway mode with API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to both Android and iOS using Termux and iSH, respectively. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and allows for scheduled tasks via cron jobs on Android.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a sandboxed environment for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-enforced security. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access alongside configurable policies for messaging and web searches.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for operating Hermes agents on Docker or Kubernetes, offering monitoring features like per-agent metrics and LLM budget caps. It provides multiple interface options including a REST API, CLI, and MCP server.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows users to build specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This NixOS module enables reproducible Hermes deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and CLI settings. It features hybrid skill management and integrates secure secrets handling via systemd EnvironmentFiles or sops-nix.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-based control plane designed to manage multiple agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. It supports hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation and enterprise MCP access for external AI client integration.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This production-oriented deployment configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian. It is designed to enable the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and integrates with Nous Portal.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from external drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in isolated offline environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework deploys specialized agents for fundamental, sentiment, and technical financial analysis. It utilizes a researcher team to conduct bullish and bearish debates, overseen by risk management and portfolio manager agents for final approvals.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, memory browsing, and cost tracking across Web UI, CLI, and REST API interfaces. It supports multi-agent workflows and can be installed locally via Node.js or deployed using Docker.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent, through TUI and web dashboards. It ensures persistent sessions via tmux integration and provides sandboxing through Docker, Podman, and Apple Containers.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This execution engine manages Hermes agents and specialist teams using the Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode. It is the first MCP engine on the Solana blockchain and features HTTP signal detection to handle payment-required states for APIs.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a level-based architecture and task bus pattern to scale Hermes Agent from single VPS instances to automated teams. It includes bundled skills for specialized operations such as security auditing, backup management, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework builds autonomous agent swarms with durable memory and MCP tool integration across more than 23 LLM providers. It features visual org charts to help users manage agent team delegation and orchestration.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work through a centralized Kanban board and review queue. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and requires human-in-the-loop verification for all proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized AI agents focused on research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for precise routing and coordination.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using MCP and ACP protocols for tool and communication handling. It features a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and task flows via Hermes Kanban.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This agent-vs-agent arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and learning, visualized through a real-time dashboard and scoreboard.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080. It uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling while performing parallel model querying and synthesis via Ollama.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool generates a local, pre-indexed code knowledge graph to reduce token usage and tool calls for coding agents. It features automatic synchronization on file changes and provides structural extraction for TypeScript, JavaScript, ArkTS, and Python.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI utility that tracks token consumption across multiple AI coding agents and IDEs. It offers a TUI and a 3D visualization dashboard, allowing users to submit usage data to a public leaderboard.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables developers to inspect API traffic from various coding agents while redacting authentication headers for security. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions, supporting tools like Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and Cursor.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of token usage, costs, and rate limits for over 35 AI coding tools. It supports multi-device synchronization and offers historical breakdowns categorized by tool, model, and project.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI assists in building interfaces by providing design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers. It integrates with any AI provider supporting markdown and is compatible with agents like Hermes, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This project serves as an opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents to build and operate applications. It includes 36 skills and 6 workflows designed for autonomous execution on laptops or VPS environments.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins allows users to customize the terminal UI of Hermes Agent with YAML-based themes. Developers can modify banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art using presets like retro DOS or cyberpunk aesthetics.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This port brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 native skills directly into the Claude Code Channel without requiring OAuth or external processes. It specifically includes MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol. It facilitates agent-to-agent commerce using Solana-based payments and human-readable identity handles.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control through the Model Context Protocol. It features a supervisor sidebar for managing workflows and includes an undo function to revert recent agent changes.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This integration suite provides memory adapters for platforms like Slack and VS Code to support frameworks such as CrewAI and LangGraph. It utilizes a two-tier system consisting of knowledge graphs and session caches.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup uses RTK and Caveman templating to achieve up to 99% token savings during agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for finance and devops, featuring automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents using per-folder configurations and local skills. It allows users to seamlessly switch between default and scoped agents while maintaining project-local memories, tools, and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of the hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It provides zero-cost access to free models and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static linter that performs local, deterministic checks on AI agent configurations and system prompts without API or telemetry calls. It flags ambiguous tool descriptions and missing termination conditions while supporting CI integration via GitHub Actions and SARIF reporting.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility moves SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills from OpenClaw into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It handles nested authentication structures and sets up systemd gateway services to facilitate the transition.
entries.observeco/observeco: This self-healing observability tool uses a native Hermes plugin to export real-time telemetry from agent conversations without cloud dependencies. It features zero-token passive analysis and active probing to detect performance drift relative to local file changes.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Designed to help users generate revenue, this local-first skill uses explicit approval contracts for external actions. It operates by accepting bounded JSON through stdin and emitting JSON responses for opportunity and offer-preview tasks.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This offline personal assistant adds voice capabilities to Hermes Agent, supporting 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro. It features adaptive turn-taking and barge-in capabilities without requiring API keys or accounts.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes supports multi-dimensional storage and semantic search functionality. It includes a circuit breaker to handle MemOS API outages and provides specific tools for searching, adding, and deleting memories.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built with Tauri 2, provides a unified desktop interface for Hermes Agent alongside other tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI. It is compatible with Windows, macOS, and Linux, serving as an all-in-one controller for multiple agent environments.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application that integrates Hermes Agent and dozens of other external agents into a single interface. It features 21 built-in professional assistants and supports remote access through a WebUI and various messaging platforms.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Built with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this web-based interface allows users to interact with Hermes Agent from browsers or mobile devices. It includes a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure access via SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app simplifies the Hermes Agent experience through guided installation and provider setup. It provides a dedicated GUI for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: Hermes Studio is a web dashboard that offers a visual workflow canvas with approval gates and unified configuration for 10 messaging platforms like Telegram and Discord. It tracks token consumption and execution history while storing session data in a local SQLite database.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex tasks. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and specialized managers for memory, skills, and MCP catalogs.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative coding workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents into a desktop, server, or Docker-based environment. It supports fifteen built-in agents and provides native iOS and Android clients for remote mobile access.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts with an embedded terminal for shell access. It features native views for managing sessions, Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application includes the Hermes-CN-Core kernel for local agent execution. The interface supports native file dialogs, memory management, and rendering for LaTeX and Mermaid diagrams.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects browser context to local or remote Hermes runtimes, including Hermes Cloud and self-hosted gateways. It features intelligent tab scoping and a Bot Mode for multi-agent switching and group chats.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app that pairs with a hermes-webui server to drive self-hosted agents via HTTPS or Tailscale. It streams real-time responses with tool-call details and allows users to manage server-side tasks, skills, and file systems.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: Wesight is a desktop workspace offering one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines with custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage, plus a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI consciousness monitor features nine tabs and four color themes for tracking agent growth and git projects. It serves as a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes and monitoring scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides real-time chat with tool call visualization and a dedicated MCP server control plane. It includes a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines alongside system metrics and session overviews.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that provides searchable transcripts and image browsing for over 14 agent formats. It operates locally without telemetry, offering analytics to attribute live quota burn to individual sessions for Codex and Claude.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It features an integrated WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and React 19, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It includes a specialized approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: This OpenTUI-based dashboard provides a terminal interface for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It supports task management through a kanban board and allows users to manage profiles, skills, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This mobile-first React SPA dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0 supports terminal chat with streaming responses and file attachments. It utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication while supporting the background spawning of five concurrent agent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application runs without admin rights or system-wide dependencies, utilizing a Tkinter GUI. It includes 100 tools for music, TTS, and ComfyUI, featuring granular permission controls and a custom tool maker.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface that provides real-time log streaming and an integrated file browser for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes a task tracking dashboard and management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This dashboard focuses on process monitoring by providing real-time session activity and cost tracking. It allows for the full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, alongside read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace featuring real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards for runtime control. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for separate sessions and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents through a PM orchestrator. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports streaming SSE responses with model switching.
